positions.title: Covid Layoff
positions.description: The mandatory vacation fairy crossed my path in a dark and stormy HR review held far, far away from my actual job.

positions.title: Principle Field Engineer
positions.description: Support, Maintain, and Q.A. classified systems provided to Boeing projects by BAE Systems.

positions.title: Contract Programmer (Via Triad Group)
positions.description: Reverse engineered network data transports of legacy medical telemetry devices to provide full backwards compatibility for the Windows XP based product platform.

positions.title: Senior Systems Programmer
positions.description: Replaced code generation system that produced 100,000 lines of generated error handling code with a single 30 line function and a set of defines, aliases, and linker directives.

positions.title: Senior Systems Programmer
positions.description:
Wholly Designed and implemented all software for the pivotal Mobile Identity Server and Client through to version 1.0 which provided central administration and distributed access to Subscriber Identity Modules (GSM SIMs) for the entire GSM test probe environment.

Design and maintain communications applications and services for cellular provider network test equipment. Network protocol design and implementation. Client/Sever design and implementation. Feature integration into remote test platforms. Ad-hoc application development. System and database administration.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Programmer
positions.description:
Design and implement systems using C & C++ within Oracle 7 and 8 (using SQL, PL/SQL, and OCI), NetExpert 3.x and Remedy ARS v3.x, Solaris 2.5 and 2.6, pthreads.

Developed Quality of Service statistical analysis programs for billing, user interface specifications, and network object model on $11 million FAATSAT contract.

Telemetry (data samples and hardware status information) delivery systems on Solaris 2.5 and 2.6 using C and C++, pthreads, sockets and UNIX kernel APIs.

Database Analyst tasks including removing 300,000 orphaned object records from, and adding  Netexpert to OpenView alarm propagator (translated NetExpert alert conditions and status information into SNMP trap events) to Defense Intelligence Services Agency network management system.

Countless utilities and "glueware" applications connecting multi-million dollar NetExpert installations to real world data sources and QA and fault testing systems.

Also Network and Unix System administrator for development environment and FAATSAT production network and Air Force internal networks at the Pentagon.

Numerous other duties not limited to interviewing job applicants, inter-project and department consulting, project design, working with subcontractors, setting various project coding, modeling and documentation standards.

positions.title: Small System & Network Manager
positions.description:
Brought National University onto the Internet (pre-web browser era).
Developed application suite to recycle and reinstall networked PCs in classrooms and labs.  [q.v. Norton Ghost™ except in dos and windows 3.1 era.]

Extensive work with AT&T 3B2 platform (Unix SVR4 reference platform) including specification and installation of replacement word processing system for University-wide word processing department, including implementation of SNA upload, import, and post processing of key data (contracts, notices, etc) from IBM 370 mainframe into Unix-based word processing system. 

Installed and maintained all the Ethernet (and AT&T StarLan™) servers, facilities and wiring.
Performed telecomm installations (phone room wring, punch downs, fiber optic planning).
Taught remedial and continuing education courses in C and network management.
